question: A square display panel is designed so that its diagonal can expand uniformly during a thermal-resistance test. Let $d$ centimetres be its diagonal, $A$ square centimetres its area and $P$ centimetres its perimeter. During one stage of the test, the diagonal increases at a constant rate of $2\ \text{cm/s}$. The engineers want to determine how this change affects both the area and perimeter when the diagonal is $10\ \text{cm}$ and to compare their relative rates of change.(a) Express $A$ and $P$ in terms of $d$.(b) Find the instantaneous rate of increase of the area when $d=10\ \text{cm}$.(c) Find the instantaneous rate of increase of the perimeter at the same instant.(d) Compare the relative rates of change of the area and perimeter.
explanation: (a)If $a$ is the side of the square, then`d=a\sqrt{2}`Therefore,`a=\frac{d}{\sqrt{2}}`The area is`A=a^2=\frac{d^2}{2}`The perimeter is`P=4a=2\sqrt{2}d`(b)Differentiating $A=\frac{d^2}{2}$ with respect to time,`\frac{dA}{dt}=d\frac{dd}{dt}`At $d=10\ \text{cm}$ and $\frac{dd}{dt}=2\ \text{cm/s}$,`\frac{dA}{dt}=10(2)=20\ \text{cm}^2/\text{s}`(c)Differentiating $P=2\sqrt{2}d$ with respect to time,`\frac{dP}{dt}=2\sqrt{2}\frac{dd}{dt}`Therefore,`\frac{dP}{dt}=2\sqrt{2}(2)=4\sqrt{2}\ \text{cm/s}`(d)When $d=10$,`A=\frac{(10)^2}{2}=50\ \text{cm}^2`Therefore, the relative rate of change of area is`\frac{1}{A}\frac{dA}{dt}=\frac{20}{50}=0.4\ \text{s}^{-1}`Also,`P=2\sqrt{2}(10)=20\sqrt{2}\ \text{cm}`The relative rate of change of perimeter is`\frac{1}{P}\frac{dP}{dt}=\frac{4\sqrt{2}}{20\sqrt{2}}=0.2\ \text{s}^{-1}`Thus, the relative rate of increase of the area is twice the relative rate of increase of the perimeter.

options.A:
(a) $A=\frac{d^2}{2},\ P=2\sqrt{2}d$
(b) $\frac{dA}{dt}=20\ \text{cm}^2/\text{s}$
(c) $\frac{dP}{dt}=4\sqrt{2}\ \text{cm/s}$
(d) Relative rates are $0.4\ \text{s}^{-1}$ and $0.2\ \text{s}^{-1}$; area rate is twice the perimeter rate
options.B:
(a) $A=d^2,\ P=4d$
(b) $\frac{dA}{dt}=40\ \text{cm}^2/\text{s}$
(c) $\frac{dP}{dt}=8\ \text{cm/s}$
(d) The two relative rates are equal
options.D:
(a) $A=2d^2,\ P=4\sqrt{2}d$
(b) $\frac{dA}{dt}=80\ \text{cm}^2/\text{s}$
(c) $\frac{dP}{dt}=8\sqrt{2}\ \text{cm/s}$
(d) Perimeter relative rate is twice the area relative rate
